subject.title: feat(ui): five-zone sidebar — agent identity card, threads/groups/coding, footer bar

question: Does the proposed five-zone sidebar hierarchy—including making the agent card the main-session entry point and collapsing Coding by default—match the intended Control UI navigation direction?
rationale: This intentionally changes the primary navigation model and default first-run presentation; the protected maintainer label requires a human owner to confirm that product direction before merge.

options.title: Sponsor the five-zone design
options.body: Confirm the navigation model, then require real browser proof covering fresh and existing local-storage states before merge.

options.title: Narrow the redesign
options.body: Keep only the desired sidebar hierarchy changes and restore any navigation affordances that product owners want to preserve.

options.title: Pause for a dedicated design decision
options.body: Hold the PR until the Control UI owner records the intended agent/session hierarchy and migration expectations.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the five-zone design
recommendation.body: Confirm the navigation model, then require real browser proof covering fresh and existing local-storage states before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied PR body describes the work as owner-directed and this person authored the proposed implementation and follow-up fixes.
